## Expression on this line

The Environmental line at orange Stage 11 is **statutorily-implemented scientific-ecological-
management** subordinated to a rights-equal-procedure regime. The transition is from amber's
environmental-protection-as-instrument-of-the-in-group's industrial-destiny to orange's
environmental-protection-as-public-domain subordinated to scientific-disciplines of measurement
and statutory-protection-with-rights-equal-procedure discipline. If the in-group industrial-
destiny conflicts with measured-ecological-discipline, the latter is statutorily-anchored-
substantive-discipline.

The structural changes are:

- **Statutory-scientific-ecological-management discipline.** Environment-disciplines-statutory-
  applied to geophysical-and-biological measurements, applied-statutory-environmental-statute-
  discipline referenced in statutes.
- **Statute-EIA-and-permit-disclosure discipline.** EIA-statutory-discipline arms-length-
  statutory with discipline-of-formal-permitting and substantive-rationale-discipline with
  statutory-decisions-findable.
- **Anti-discrimination-statutory-equality-disciplines applied to environmental-domain.** The
  discipline-applied-statutory-equality-of-ecological-protection irrespective-of-in-group-
  affiliation discipline.
- **Cross-jurisdiction environmental-cohort active and operative.** Cross-jurisdiction-
  scientific-coherent-ecological-cooperation and standards-statutory-discipline.
- **Statute-for-environmental-claims-of-individuals.** Environmental-claims-of-individuals
  recognized-as-a-statute right; available-statutory-jurisprudence track.
- **Statute-of-generational-equity.** Generational-equity-statute-with-statutory-procedural-and-
  substantive-rationale-discipline on environmental-projects.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from orange-11)

- **UL:** the practitioner's *vocation-of-independent-ecological-discipline-from-political-press*;
  the craftsman-ecologist's-dedication-to-evidence-and-method.
- **UR:** independent-statutory-environmental-statutory-discipline-and-statutory-effectiveness;
  statutory-EIA-and-permit-disclosure-statutory-cycle-ratchet.
- **LL:** *civic-faith-in-statutory-environmental-equality*: a polity that recognizes the
  environmental-domain as a public-domain bound by rights-equal-procedure and applied-
  scientific-measurement rather than as a service of the in-group's industrial-destiny.
- **LR:** statutory-environmental-statute, statutory-EIA-disclosure discipline, anti-discrimination
  statute applied-to-environmental-domain, statutorily-published-environmental-data,
  cross-jurisdiction-statute-cooperation.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to orange-11):** **discipline-by-published-statutes-and-statistical
  discipline** — modern-statute-discipline-without-statute-statistical-discipline-effective
  discipline, the discipline-statute-form becoming its own loyalty-network; discipline-of-
  statutory-substantive-rationale substituting-for-disciplinary-discipline-of-ecological-
  standing.
- **Dark allergy (orange-11 foundation skipped/fragile):** statutory-environmental-statute on
  statute-book with operating-ecological-discipline-discipline-fit-press; independent-statutory
  discipline-statute-effectively-vs-statutory-cap-lowered-with-public-press; recurring-
  exceptional-amendment-discipline-statistical.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Green prematurely):** **multi-stakeholder-networked-environmental-
  governance-and-discourse** as substitute for environmental-as-public-domain bound by rights-
  equal-procedure-discipline; multi-stakeholder-objects-substituting-statute-discipline.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing orange-11):** nativist-refusal to the worldcentric turn of
  considering-environment-as-public-domain; "our land, our environmental-policy"; refusal-of-
  cross-jurisdiction-statutory-cooperation-discipline.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types** that place an environmental-system holon at **orange Stage 11**.

- **Statutory-disclosure-and-statute-application-effective.** A pattern-of-statutory-applied-to-
  environmental-decisions, with statutory-disclosure-ratchet-statistical-statistical discipline.
- **Independent-statute-disciplines-operational.** Statutory-and-effective-track-record-of-ecology-
  regulator-discipline-statute applied independent of executive-statute-pressure; statutory-
  decision-discipline.
- **Cross-jurisdiction-cooperation-statutory-active.** Active-participation-in-international-
  environmental-regime cohort; cross-jurisdiction-cooperation-statutory-statistical-effective.
- **Statutory-environmental-claims-operational.** Statutory-environmental-claims-of-individuals
  mechanism present and effective; statutory-ruling-ratchet.
- **Generational-equity-statute-operational.** Statutory-generational-equity-statute or
  comparable operative.
- **Anti-discrimination-statute-applied.** Statutory-antidiscrimination applicable with case-
  trend statistics substantively-applied to environmental-domain.
- **Permit-and-exemption-decisions-published-rationale-applied-statutory-discipline.** Permit-
  and exemption-decisions published-substantive-rationale; trends-of-statutory-permit-finding
  by type-of-disparity.

## Sources, joints, open questions

- **Sources:** Wilber, *Integral Psychology* (altitude/orange); Beck & Cowan, *Spiral Dynamics*
  (worldcentric emergence); Commons/MHC Order 10 (Abstract); Kegan, *In Over Our Heads*
  (order 3 → 4); Ostrom, *Governing the Commons*; Ostrom's analytical-framework formulations;
  *The SAGE Handbook of Environmental Governance*; Stern Review of the Economics of Climate
  Change (generic-form); Costanza's *The Economics of Sustainability* (generic-form); Daly
  (steady-state economics); the OECD Environmental Performance Reviews series; Sachs's
  *The Age of Sustainable Development*; UNEP statistical series.

- **Open joints:** What institutional carriers carry the orange environmental-domain's

  turn? Is there an orange-stable equilibrium where scientific-and-statutory-discipline-arms-
  length remains consistent with cross-economy-industrial-or-visual reality without becoming
  a wholly-distillation-of-the-environment-as-public-domain-discipline?
